description: What a model reads from list_context, per what the page lists (#302). Handwritten: bytes and digests were computed outside either implementation. The marker is a fixed one; a run draws its own.

items.name: a key that closes the block and speaks
items.why: The marker comes out of the data, and the words stay inside the block.

items.name: an ordinary key
items.why: A key is a source's text however it reads, so the rule is not a grammar for keys.

items.name: a key beside a content part
items.why: A content part's members other than the result's own are a source's too.

items.name: a source's result with text only
items.why: It names only the result's own members, so the bytes do not move.

items.name: no result at all
items.why: A request and a history row name no key of a tool.

items.name: a delegated task's findings
items.why: The package writes these members, not a source.
